description: Layer-3 semantic-eval cases for `cargo xtask semantic-eval`. Each case pins a (chunk_hash, claim_window_hash) pair against the committed QM B1 cache at the path below; the runner asserts the lookup's actual verdict matches expected_verdict. Pass and fail cases are drawn from the committed cache; abstain cases use synthetic 64-hex pairs that the cache does not contain, so the lookup returns the abstain-embedding-cache sentinel. The schema is intentionally distinct from tests/retrieval_eval/eval_cases.json (different schema_version literal + different case shape) so neither suite's fixture can quietly drift into the other's shape.
